key_provisions_or_claims: Adds four persons and six entities to Annex I of Decision (CFSP) 2023/1532 sanctions list
Listings target Iran's UAV and ballistic missile programmes supporting Russia's war against Ukraine
Includes Sahara Thunder, a MODAFL front company supplying UAVs to Russia
Enters into force on publication in the Official Journal
annotation.summary_en: Council Decision (CFSP) 2026/263 amends the EU's Iran restrictive-measures Decision 2023/1532, adding four persons and six entities to the sanctions list for involvement in Iran's drone and ballistic missile programmes supporting Russia's war against Ukraine.
annotation.title_clean: Council Decision (CFSP) 2026/263 of 29 January 2026 amending Decision (CFSP) 2023/1532 concerning restrictive measures in view of Iran's military support to Russia's war of aggression against Ukraine and to armed groups and entities in the Middle East and the Red Sea region
